### User interactions

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Horizontal or vertical scrolling | Scroll to reveal items outside the visible area. |
| Links and controls | Use embedded items normally. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves focus to the slider, then to its focusable children. |
| <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> | Scrolls the focused slider left or right by 80% of its visible width. |
| <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> | Scrolls the focused vertical slider by 80% of its visible height. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Scrolls the focused slider to the start or end of its content, respecting text direction. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
